answer: The Bell-state job ran and completed on the Garnet mock with 100 shots. The counts were 00: 25, 01: 23, 10: 29, and 11: 23. The task asked for "garnet-mock", but the server has no alias with that name. The server lists "garnet:mock", which is the Garnet mock, so I used that. No real QPU was used. The job ID is 01a15fb0-6d6e-743c-9b86-a929a682db12. The circuit applied H on qubit 0 and a CNOT from qubit 0 to qubit 1, then measured both qubits. The bitstrings use Qiskit order. The mock returns random results, so the counts are spread evenly across all four outcomes. A real Bell state would give mostly 00 and 11.
